snippet.title: Wormies | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Wormies on Steam today! Coming April 16th 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4058290/Wormies/

Wormies is a cozy indie game about running your own wormie shop. Breed hundreds of different wormies, from food to animal wormies! Get to know your customers and fulfill their wormie orders to progress through different storylines!

#gametrailer #cozygames #wholesomegames
